items.exampleEn: She works as a tailor in a small shop downtown.
items.exampleZh: 她在市區一家小店當裁縫。

items.exampleEn: Sitting at a desk all day can affect your posture.
items.exampleZh: 整天坐在辦公桌前可能會影響你的姿勢。

items.exampleEn: Her facial expression showed that she was surprised.
items.exampleZh: 她的臉部表情顯示她很驚訝。

items.exampleEn: The dancer has a strong, muscular body.
items.exampleZh: 那位舞者有著強壯又結實的身材。

items.exampleEn: Fans can now buy the team's new jersey online.
items.exampleZh: 球迷現在可以在網路上買到球隊的新球衣。

items.exampleEn: Diamonds are the hardest of all gems.
items.exampleZh: 鑽石是所有寶石中最堅硬的。

items.exampleEn: The dress has a simple, elegant silhouette.
items.exampleZh: 這件洋裝的輪廓簡單又優雅。

items.exampleEn: In the old story, the magician wears a cloak that makes him invisible.
items.exampleZh: 在那個古老的故事裡，魔術師穿著一件能讓他隱形的斗篷。

items.sentenceEn: The tailor made my pants shorter in just one day.
items.sentenceZh: 裁縫只花一天就把我的褲子改短了。

items.audioEn: Wearing his team's jersey, my older brother cheered loudly for two hours.
items.audioZh: 我哥哥穿著他球隊的球衣，大聲加油了兩個小時。

items.sentenceEn: Good posture can make you look more confident.
items.sentenceZh: 好的姿勢能讓你看起來更有自信。

items.sentenceEn: The actor's facial expressions told the whole story.
items.sentenceZh: 那位演員的臉部表情說出了整個故事。

items.stemEn: After months at the gym, his arms have become very ____.
items.stemZh: 上了幾個月健身房之後，他的手臂變得很結實。

items.stemEn: In the evening light, we could see the ____ of the mountains against the sky.
items.stemZh: 在傍晚的光線中，我們看得見山脈映在天空下的剪影。

items.passageEn: For the school play, my younger sister needed a costume for the role of a queen. A local tailor offered to make a long red cloak for her, and her friends decorated a crown with plastic gems. During practice, the director kept reminding her about her posture: "A queen never looks at the floor!" On the night of the show, the stage lights turned her into a dark silhouette at the start of the first scene, and the audience went quiet. Her partner, a muscular boy from the basketball team, played the king and wore his basketball jersey under his long coat. It was an exhilarating evening for the whole family.
items.passageZh: 為了學校話劇，我妹妹需要一套扮演皇后的戲服。當地一位裁縫主動幫她做了一件紅色長斗篷，她的朋友們則用塑膠寶石裝飾了一頂皇冠。排練時，導演一直提醒她注意姿勢：「皇后從不看地板！」演出當晚，第一幕開始時，舞台燈光讓她成了一道黑色剪影，觀眾都安靜了下來。和她搭檔的是籃球隊一位很壯的男生，他飾演國王，還在長外套底下穿著籃球衣。對全家人來說，那是一個令人興奮的夜晚。

questions.questionZh: 朋友們用什麼裝飾皇冠？
排練時導演一直提醒她什麼？

items.promptZh: 這門課可以依照每位學生的需要來調整。
referenceEn: The course can be tailored to each student's needs.
We can tailor this course to the needs of every student.
rubricZh: tailor 當動詞表示「量身調整」，用法例如 tailor A to B、be tailored to… 等
「需要」可寫，例如 needs、what each student needs 等

items.promptZh: 這家小餐館是當地人才知道的私房好店。
referenceEn: This small restaurant is a hidden gem that only local people know about.
Only locals know about this little restaurant; it's a real gem.
rubricZh: 「私房好店」用 gem，例如 a hidden gem、a real gem 等
「當地人」可寫，例如 local people、locals 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：正解「注意姿勢，皇后不會看地板」是四選項中唯一最長且最完整的（長度約為其他選項平均的 1.9 倍），又幾乎照抄短文原句，長度洩題（§11-24）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 正解改寫成不照抄原文的「要抬頭挺胸、注意姿勢」，干擾項加長，正解長度比降到約 1.25 倍

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似：audioEn 只說 his team's jersey，中譯「他支持球隊的球衣」多加了「支持」（his team 也可能是他自己所屬的隊）；建議「他球隊的球衣」。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: audioEn 改 my older brother，中譯改「我哥哥穿著他球隊的球衣」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 自查修正：自查：my sister 譯「妹妹」多加了長幼資訊
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 英文改 my younger sister，與中譯一致

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：tailor 當動詞表示「量身調整」，用法例如 tailor A to B、be tailored to… 等／「需要」可寫，例如 needs、what each student needs 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：gem 可比喻「珍貴的人或物」（例如 a hidden gem、a real gem 等）／句子要說到你自己知道的地方或東西

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（gem）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u11-l01-q17；目標字沿用 gem
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「這家小餐館是當地人才知道的私房好店。」、hintWords ["gem"]、referenceEn ["This small restaurant is a hidden gem that only local people know about.","Only locals know about this little restaurant; it's a real gem."]、rubricZh ["「私房好店」用 gem，例如 a hidden gem、a real gem 等","「當地人」可寫，例如 local people、locals 等"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 gem 造一個句子，介紹一個你覺得是「寶」的地方或東西。」、referenceEn ["This small bookshop is a hidden gem in my neighborhood.","My grandmother's old recipe book is a real gem."]）
